title: Teacher Bai's Friend Metaverse World
tagline: This is the project for NFT in Metaverse for Teacher Bai's Best Friend - Xiao Shan!
description:
This project generates metaverse with minted Xiao Shan NFT generated with polygon. The whole service is written in React and Remix. The NFT service is deployed in Polygon.

Xiao Shan NFT is a female kitten cat that's Teacher Bai's best friend. Our motivation is create a new home for her in Web3, and let everyone enjoy her there!
how_its_made: This project uses polygon network to generate Xiao Shan NFT in minting dapp, and created a Web based metaverse using JavaScript. We did use own drawing skills to make 1200+ NFTs for Xiao Shan - our kitten cat. We access Polygon network to gather your Xiao Shan NFT and use them to create the metaverse using HTML5/CSS. We used the above technologies to create a new home for her in Web3, and let everyone enjoy her there!
